**Ludora - the Client for all Game Clients** · Release 0.7.4

### What's new
- **New “Stream” tab in the library:** all games that aren't installed here but are installed on another of your devices that's currently on and signed in to Steam (PC, laptop, Steam Deck) – each with a **Stream** button (Steam Remote Play). The tab shows how many games you can stream right now; the “Runs on …” filter doesn't apply there, since the game runs on the other device.
- Prepared for other launchers: as soon as another launcher offers streaming between your devices, it can be added in one place.

### Downloads
| System | File |
|---|---|
| Windows 10/11 | `Ludora-Setup-0.7.4.exe` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon M1–M4) | `Ludora-0.7.4-arm64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| macOS (Intel) | `Ludora-0.7.4-x64.dmg` (or `.zip`) |
| Linux (any distribution) | `Ludora-0.7.4-x86_64.AppImage` |
| Debian / Ubuntu | `Ludora-0.7.4-amd64.deb` |

The files are not code-signed: on Windows click **More info → Run anyway**, on macOS **right-click → Open** on the first start.
